entry.title: How I screened six AI tools before adoption
entry.summary: How I evaluated six trending AI tools: one adopted with a pinned commit after reading every file, four parts cherry-picked manually from a ~300-skill bundle, and four rejected over prompt and telemetry flow.

entry.title: An empty source is not a successful backup
entry.summary: After an object-storage rebuild, restoring backups (~5.6 GB across two buckets, zero diff) exposed a deeper gap: a backup job that could treat zero objects at the source as success.

entry.title: Reading silenced alerts as a separate list
entry.summary: Inspecting active and silenced alerts as two separate lists prevents known issues from looking like new critical incidents when they resurface.

entry.title: Avoiding duplicate work across parallel AI sessions
entry.summary: Running several AI sessions in parallel duplicated work twice until I adopted a two-line rule: one owner before starting and a cross-check at the end of the day (8.5 hours logged, 0 duplicate work).

entry.title: I attacked my own RAG bot. 7 of 10 attacks worked.
entry.summary: A red-team run against a small RAG support bot: 7 of 10 attacks worked before defences were added. What worked, what stopped it, and what still gets through.
